invariants.rationale: The method will sort and return the list; a null input would likely be invalid and cause an exception.
Partitions are usually positive; a non-positive partition count likely indicates a precondition violation.
records is declared as a List, so the expected input type is List.
List.size() is always non-negative as per the List contract.
Typically, the number of output partitions should not exceed the number of records unless the list is empty.
